item.title: Chung Dong-young Visits Mongolia…Special Speech at "Ulaanbaatar Dialogue" (정동영 몽골 방문...‘울란바타르 대화’ 특별연설)
item.description:
Chung Dong-young Visits Mongolia…Special Speech at "Ulaanbaatar Dialogue" (정동영 몽골 방문...‘울란바타르 대화’ 특별연설 )

Unification Minister Chung Dong-young will deliver a special speech at the 11th "Ulaanbaatar Northeast Asian Security Dialogue" held in Ulaanbaatar, Mongolia on the 4th. (정동영 통일부 장관이 4일 몽골 울란바타르에서 개최되는 제11차 ‘울란바타르 동북아 안보 대화’의 특별연설 연사로 나선다.)

The Ministry of Unification announced on the 3rd that Minister Chung will visit Mongolia from the same day through the 6th, for a four-day, three-night schedule. This marks the first visit to Mongolia by a Unification Minister and the first attendance at the "Ulaanbaatar Dialogue." (통일부는 3일 정 장관이 이날부터 오는 6일까지 3박4일 일정으로 몽골을 방문한다고 밝혔다. 통일부 장관의 몽골 방문 및 ‘울란바타르 대화’ 참석은 이번이 처음이다.)

The "Ulaanbaatar Dialogue" is a multilateral security dialogue for Northeast Asia, initiated by the Mongolian government in 2014. It is a regular international conference that comprehensively addresses traditional and non-traditional security issues, including regional security, energy, and the environment. It functions as a 1.5-track dialogue, involving government officials, academics, and representatives from international organizations within the region. (‘울란바타르 대화’는 몽골 정부 주도로 2014년부터 열리는 동북아 지역의 다자 안보 대화체다. 동북아 안보·에너지·환경 등 전통적·비전통적 안보 이슈를 포괄적으로 다루는 정례적 국제회의다. 역내 국가의 정부 인사, 학계인사, 국제기구 관계자들이 참여하는 1.5트랙 성격의 대화체다.)

Minister Chung is scheduled to deliver a "special speech" at the opening ceremony on the first day of the meeting. A Ministry of Unification official stated, "The Mongolian government has repeatedly requested his attendance since the beginning of the year," adding, "During his two-day stay in Mongolia, Minister Chung plans to hold meetings with key Mongolian government and parliamentary figures to garner support and understanding for the policy of peaceful coexistence on the Korean Peninsula, and to extensively discuss cooperation plans with Mongolia to this end." (정 장관은 회의 첫날 개회식에서 ‘특별 연설’을 할 예정이다. 통일부 당국자는 “몽골 정부에서 연초부터 여러 차례에 걸쳐 참석 요청이 있었다”며 “정동영 장관은 몽골에 체류하는 이틀 동안 몽골의 주요 정부·의회 인사들과의 면담을 통해 한반도 평화 공존 정책에 대한 지지와 공감을 이끌어내고 이를 위한 몽골과의 협력 방안 등에 대해 폭넓게 논의할 예정”이라고 했다.)

Approximately 250 participants from 25 countries have confirmed attendance at this "Ulaanbaatar Dialogue." North Korea's participation remains uncertain. Mongolia has established diplomatic relations with both South and North Korea. Since establishing ties in 1948, Mongolia and North Korea have maintained friendly cooperative relations as socialist countries. Kim Il-sung visited Mongolia in 1956 and 1988, and the secretary-general of the Mongolian party visited Pyongyang in 1958 and 1986. High-level people-to-people exchanges between the two countries have continued, including Mongolian President Tsakhiagiin Elbegdorj's visit to North Korea in 2013 and a North Korean Foreign Ministry delegation's visit to Mongolia in March 2024. (이번 ‘울란바타르 대화’에는 25국에서 약 250명이 참석을 확정한 상태다. 북한의 참석 여부는 미지수다. 몽골은 남북 양쪽 모두와 외교관계를 수립한 국가다. 몽골과 북한은 1948년 수교 이후 사회주의 국가로서 우호협력 관계를 유지하고 있다. 1956년과 1988년에 김일성이 몽골을 방문했고, 1958면과 1986년엔 몽골의 당 서기장이 방북했다. 2013년 짜히아긴 엘베그드로쥐 몽골 대통령이 방북하고 2024년 3월 북한 외무성 대표단이 몽골을 방문하는 등 양국 간 고위급 인적 교류는 지속되고 있다.)

Due to this friendly relationship between Mongolia and North Korea, there is speculation that the "Ulaanbaatar Dialogue" could serve as an opportunity for Mongolia to mediate inter-Korean or U.S.-North Korea dialogue. This is because past "Ulaanbaatar Dialogues" have facilitated U.S.-North Korea and Japan-North Korea contacts in Mongolia. (이러한 몽골과 북한의 우호적 관계 때문에 이번 ‘울란바타르 대화’를 계기로 몽골이 남북 대화 및 미북 대화 중재에 나설 가능성도 거론된다. 과거 ‘울란바타르 대화’를 통해 북미, 북일 접촉이 몽골에서 이뤄진 적이 있기 때문이다.)

If North Korea attends, there is interest in whether private contacts between the two Koreas or between the U.S. and North Korea might take place on the sidelines of the "Ulaanbaatar Dialogue." North Korea participated in the "Ulaanbaatar Dialogue" from 2014 to 2018 but has been absent since 2019. In 2017, Ri Yong-pil, Deputy Director of the Foreign Ministry's Institute for American Studies, attended, and in 2018, Kim Yong-guk, Director of the Foreign Ministry's Institute for Disarmament and Peace, participated. (북한이 참석한다면 ‘울란바타르 대화’를 계기로 남북, 미북 간 비공개 접촉이 이뤄질지도 관심이다. 북한은 2014년부터 2018년까지 ‘울란바타르 대화’에 참여했으나 2019년 이후 불참하고 있다. 2017년엔 리용필 외무성 미국연구소 부소장이 2018년엔 김용국 외무성 군축평화연구소 소장이 울란바타르 대화에 참석했었다.)

A Ministry of Unification official stated, "If there is a natural opportunity to engage with the North Korean side (at the Ulaanbaatar Dialogue), we plan to use that opportunity to explain our government's commitment to the policy of peaceful coexistence on the Korean Peninsula and urge the necessity of inter-Korean dialogue for the sake of peaceful coexistence." (통일부 당국자는 “(울란바타르 대화에서)북측과 자연스럽게 접촉할 수 있는 계기가 있다면 그런 계기를 통해 우리 정부가 가진 한반도 평화 공존 정책에 대한 의지도 설명하고 한반도 평화 공존을 위해 남북 간 대화의 필요성에 대해서도 촉구할 생각”이라고 했다.)

item.title: "10 Years of Incompetence and Irresponsibility Must Be Judged" vs. "Can't Entrust Seoul to a Novice Driver" (“무능·무책임 10년 심판해야” vs “초보 운전자에 서울 못 맡겨”)
item.description:
"10 Years of Incompetence and Irresponsibility Must Be Judged" vs. "Can't Entrust Seoul to a Novice Driver" (“무능·무책임 10년 심판해야” vs “초보 운전자에 서울 못 맡겨”)

On the 2nd, one day before the June 3 local elections, the ruling and opposition parties waged an all-out battle in Seoul, the biggest battleground. The Democratic Party aims to reclaim Seoul, while the People Power Party seeks to hold onto it as the top goal of this election. Democratic Party candidate Jung Won-oh stated in his final campaign rally that day, "This election is one that empowers the Lee Jae-myung administration," pushing a 'support for the administration' narrative, while People Power Party candidate Oh Se-hoon emphasized "Seoul is the last bastion for checking the administration," advocating for 'checking the massive ruling party.' <<> Candidate Jung Won-oh held a joint press conference with Democratic Party district office candidates from all 25 districts of Seoul at the National Assembly that morning, saying, "There will be a stern judgment on the 10 years of incompetence, irresponsibility, and complacency (by candidate Oh)." Jung promoted the Lee Jae-myung administration's 'stability in state affairs' narrative. He stated, "This election is not simply about choosing one Seoul mayor; it's an election to empower the Lee Jae-myung administration. For the government and Seoul to work as one team, Jung Won-oh and the Democratic Party district office candidates must all be elected together." <<> In a final campaign rally at Cheonggye Plaza that evening, alongside party leadership including Chairman Jung Cheong-rae, Jung said, "The term of the Seoul mayor elected tomorrow exactly matches the remaining term of President Lee. As a 'work-expert' mayor who understands with just a glance, I will work in step with President Lee Jae-myung to solve Seoul's problems." He then targeted Oh, asking, "Will you fight with the president for the entire four years?" <<> Candidate Oh Se-hoon, at a press conference in front of Hyochang Park Station in Yongsan that day, appealed for support, saying a role was needed to check the one-sided dominance of the Lee Jae-myung administration and the Democratic Party. He argued, "A country where both sides check each other is safer than one where one side takes everything. Please leave at least one final safety net so that South Korea doesn't completely tilt to one side. Leave at least Seoul, the last bastion." <<> Oh further stated, "We cannot turn the Seoul city government into a practice course for a novice driver. We cannot entrust Seoul to candidate Jung Won-oh, who lacks qualifications and preparation. What's needed at this critical time when we must leap forward as a world-class city is a seasoned veteran who can start working the day after the election." <<> Oh held his final campaign rally that evening at the Star Plaza near Sinchon Station, an area packed with universities. Explaining why he chose this location, Oh said, "During the campaign period, it was our young people who gave me the most energy. I will create Seoul, the capital and heart of South Korea, where young people can paint a bright future." He then moved to the Gwanghwamun Garden of Gratitude to wrap up his schedule. Unlike Jung, who conducted his final campaign with Chairman Jung Cheong-rae, Oh campaigned alone without People Power Party leader Jang Dong-hyuk. <<> With support ratings in a tight race, both Jung and Oh believe turnout will ultimately decide the outcome and appealed for a 'total mobilization of their support bases.' The Democratic Party views the potential defection of voters in their 30s angered by the jeonse and monthly rent crisis as a key variable, while the People Power Party focuses on whether conservative voters in areas like Gangnam, who had distanced themselves from politics amid the 'Yoon Suk Yeol impeachment crisis,' will regroup. <<> In the early voting on the 29th and 30th, preliminary turnout in areas with strong Democratic Party leanings—Nowon (24.11%), Dobong (25.53%), and Gangbuk (24.12%) districts in Seoul—was higher than the national average (23.51%). An aide to Jung said, "The consolidation of our support base is strengthening. We believe a higher turnout favors the Democratic Party." <<> In contrast, among Gangnam's four districts (Gangnam, Seocho, Songpa, Gangdong)—Oh's traditional support base—Gangnam and Seocho recorded the lowest rates in Seoul at 19.09% and 20.88% respectively. However, during the 2022 local elections, early voting in Gangnam and Seocho was also low, but final turnout reached 53.6% and 56%, exceeding Seoul's average (53.17%). An Oh campaign aide commented, "During the 2010 Seoul mayoral election, when he faced Democratic candidate Han Myeong-sook, a landslide of votes for Oh from Gangnam's three districts turned the tide. This time, the mindset of checking the administration is expected to kick in as well." (6·3 지방선거를 하루 앞둔 2일, 여야는 최대 승부처인 서울에서 총력전을 벌였다. 민주당은 서울 탈환을, 국민의힘은 서울 사수를 이번 선거 최대 목표로 삼고 있다. 민주당 정원오 후보는 이날 마지막 유세에서 “이번 선거는 이재명 정부에 힘을 싣는 선거”라며 ‘정권 지원론’을, 국민의힘 오세훈 후보는 “정권 견제의 최후 보루는 서울”이라며 ‘거대 여당 견제론’을 앞세웠다.)

item.title: "If you vote for Jeon Jae-soo, Busan will change" "Park Hyung-joon is the Nakdong River stronghold" (“전재수 뽑으면 부산 바뀐다” “박형준이 낙동강의 보루”)
item.description:
"If you vote for Jeon Jae-soo, Busan will change" "Park Hyung-joon is the Nakdong River stronghold" (“전재수 뽑으면 부산 바뀐다” “박형준이 낙동강의 보루”)

On the 2nd, the day before the June 3 local elections, the ruling and opposition candidates for city and provincial governors in Busan and South Gyeongsang launched a final all-out campaign for the last vote. Both the Democratic Party and the People Power Party view Busan and South Gyeongsang as battlegrounds where the election outcomes are uncertain. (6·3 지방선거 전날인 2일 부산·경남의 여야 시·도지사 후보들은 마지막 한 표를 위한 총력 유세에 나섰다. 부산·경남은 더불어민주당과 국민의힘 모두 선거 결과를 알 수 없는 격전지로 보고 있다.)

Democratic Party candidate Jeon Jae-soo, running in the Busan mayoral election, and People Power Party candidate Park Hyung-joon campaigned hard in their final rallies, with Jeon advocating for "government support" and Park calling for "government checks." On this day, Jeon visited Yeongdo-gu, Seo-gu, Saha-gu, and Busanjin-gu in Busan, appealing for support. "The changes that will transform Busan’s fate, including the relocation of the Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries to Busan, attracting major shipping companies like HMM, and the era of the Arctic Route, have already begun," Jeon said. "If you choose Jeon Jae-soo, Busan will change." (부산시장 선거에 나선 민주당 전재수 후보는 ‘정부 지원론’, 국민의힘 박형준 후보는 ‘정부 견제론’을 외치며 마지막 유세를 벌였다. 전재수 후보는 이날 부산 영도구·서구·사하구·부산진구 등을 돌며 지지를 호소했다. 전 후보는 이날 “해양수산부 부산 이전, HMM을 비롯한 해운 대기업 유치, 북극항로 시대까지 부산의 운명을 바꿀 변화는 이미 시작됐다”면서 “전재수를 선택하면 부산이 바뀐다”고 했다.)

In particular, Jeon selected Buk-gu District 'A' (Buk-gap) in Busan, where a by-election is being held due to his mayoral run, as his final campaign stop. At this event, Jeon, along with Democratic Party candidate Ha Jeong-woo for Buk-gap, made a last-ditch appeal for voters. The western Busan area, where Buk-gap is located, has a progressive support base comparable to its conservative support. (특히 전 후보는 자신의 부산시장 선거 출마로 보궐선거가 치러지는 부산 북갑을 마지막 유세 현장으로 선택했다. 이 자리에서 전 후보는 민주당 하정우 북갑 후보와 함께 막판 표심을 호소했다. 부산 북갑이 위치한 서(西)부산 지역은 보수 지지세 못지않게 진보 지지세도 있는 지역이다.)

Park Hyung-joon met with Busan voters in Geumjeong-gu, Dongnae-gu, Haeundae-gu, Yeonje-gu, and Busanjin-gu on this day. In the evening, he visited areas with large youth populations, such as Seomyeon Station in Busanjin-gu and the Jeonpo Café Street, for a final appeal for support. "We must protect Busan, the last bastion of the Nakdong River front," Park said. "Once the election is over, I will once again take the lead in conservative unity and reform. Grant me that momentum." (박형준 후보는 이날 금정구·동래구·해운대구·연제구·부산진구 등에서 부산 유권자들을 만났다. 이날 저녁에는 부산 중심가인 부산진구 서면역과 전포 카페 거리 등 청년층이 많이 모이는 곳을 찾아 마지막 지지 호소를 했다. 박 후보는 이날 “낙동강 전선의 최후 보루 부산만은 지켜야 한다”며 “선거가 끝나면 다시 한번 보수의 통합과 쇄신에 앞장서겠다. 저에게 그 동력을 달라”고도 했다.)

The South Gyeongsang governor race, another tight contest, also remained fierce until the end. Democratic Party candidate Kim Kyoung-soo and People Power Party candidate Park Wan-soo held their final campaigns in Changwon, which accounts for one-third of South Gyeongsang's population of 3.2 million (1 million). (다른 접전지인 경남지사 선거전도 막판까지 치열했다. 민주당 김경수, 국민의힘 박완수 후보는 이날 경남 인구(320만명)의 3분의 1을 차지하는 창원(100만명)에서 마지막 유세를 했다.)

Kim Kyoung-soo visited Jinhae and Gimhae to meet voters before concluding his campaign in Changwon. "What we need now is a capable governor," Kim said. "I will open a true golden age for South Gyeongsang, stronger than the industrialization era." (김경수 후보는 이날 진해, 김해를 돌면서 유권자들을 만난 뒤 창원에서 유세를 마무리했다. 김 후보는 “지금 필요한 것은 유능한 도지사”라면서 “산업화 시대보다 강한 경남의 진짜 전성기를 열겠다”고 했다.)

Park Wan-soo focused his campaign in Changwon. "This election is about choosing who truly knows South Gyeongsang's administration and can deliver results," Park said. "I, Park Wan-soo, have never left South Gyeongsang." <<>> (박완수 후보는 창원에서 집중 유세를 펼쳤다. 박 후보는 “이번 선거는 누가 경남의 살림을 제대로 알고, 성과를 만들어낼 수 있느냐를 선택하는 선거”라며 “저 박완수는 경남을 떠나지 않았다”고 했다.)

item.title: If They Lose This, It Hurts More Than Anywhere Else… Jeong Cheong-rae in Jeonbuk, Jang Dong-hyeok in Busan (여기 뺏기면 그 어디보다 아프다… 정청래는 전북, 장동혁은 부산)
item.description:
If They Lose This, It Hurts More Than Anywhere Else… Jeong Cheong-rae in Jeonbuk, Jang Dong-hyeok in Busan (여기 뺏기면 그 어디보다 아프다… 정청래는 전북, 장동혁은 부산)

In political circles, the June 3 local elections are seen as a decisive factor in the future of Democratic Party leader Jeong Cheong-rae and People Power Party leader Jang Dong-hyeok. Democratic Party leader Jeong Cheong-rae is highly likely to run for re-election as party leader at the party’s national convention, scheduled for late August or early September, and the local election results are intertwined with his chances of staying on. As for People Power Party leader Jang Dong-hyeok, there are voices within the party calling for his resignation after the local elections, drawing attention to the election outcomes. (정치권에선 6·3 지방선거가 더불어민주당 정청래 대표와 국민의힘 장동혁 대표의 향후 거취를 결정할 것으로 보고 있다. 민주당 정청래 대표는 8월 말 또는 9월 초 열리는 민주당 전당대회에서 당대표로 재출마할 가능성이 높은데, 지방선거 결과가 연임 여부와 맞물려 있는 셈이다. 국민의힘 장동혁 대표도 당내에선 지방선거 이후 사퇴해야 한다는 주장이 나오는 상황이라 선거 결과가 주목된다.)

Democratic Party leader Jeong Cheong-rae is expected to be considered successful if his party wins at least 10 out of 16 regional government head elections, including Seoul and Busan. This is because the elections come one year after the launch of the Lee Jae-myung administration, and internal strife within the People Power Party initially led to expectations of a landslide victory for the Democratic Party. In the 2018 local elections, held before the integration of South Jeolla and Gwangju, the Democratic Party won 14 out of 17 regional government head positions. (민주당 정청래 대표는 16곳의 광역 단체장 선거에서 서울·부산 포함 최소 10곳 이상을 이겨야 성공했다는 평가를 받을 것으로 보인다. 이재명 정부 출범 1년 만의 선거이고, 국민의힘 내분으로 당초 민주당 압승이 예상됐기 때문이다. 민주당은 전남·광주 통합 전 치러진 2018년 지방선거에서 17곳 광역 단체장 가운데 14곳에서 승리했다.)

As for Director Jang, who was at the center of internal factional conflicts, he has fielded 11 incumbent regional government heads as candidates, so there are calls for him to achieve results beyond just holding onto Daegu and North Gyeongsang. Director Jang previously stated about the Seoul and Busan elections, “My political life is at stake.” If the results are unfavorable, he could face criticism for “clinging only to hardcore supporters and losing public sentiment,” along with calls for his early resignation. (당내 노선 갈등의 중심이었던 장 대표 역시 현역 단체장 출신 11명을 그대로 후보로 내세운 만큼 대구·경북 수성 이상의 성과를 내야 한다는 말이 나온다. 장 대표는 앞서 서울·부산 선거에 대해 “내 정치 생명이 걸렸다”고 했다. 결과가 좋지 않을 경우 “강성 지지층에만 매달리다 민심을 잃었다”는 비판과 함께 조기 퇴진론에 직면할 수 있다.)

Wins or losses in regions that experienced “nomination turmoil” are also expected to impact the political futures of both party leaders. The Democratic Party expelled independent candidate Kim Kwan-young on the same day allegations of “providing a designated driver fee” emerged, while it did not take action against Democratic Party candidate Lee Won-taek over suspicions related to money. Kim Kwan-young, in protest, ran as an independent, positioning himself as a judgment on Director Jeong. Currently, Democratic Party candidate Lee Won-taek and independent candidate Kim Kwan-young are in a tight race. (‘공천 파동’을 겪은 지역에서의 승패도 여야 대표의 정치적 미래에 영향을 미칠 전망이다. 민주당은 무소속 김관영 후보를 ‘대리 운전비 제공’ 의혹이 불거진 당일 제명한 반면, 민주당 이원택 후보의 금품 관련 의혹은 처분하지 않았다. 김관영 후보가 이에 반발해 무소속 출마하면서 정 대표 심판을 내세웠다. 현재 민주당 이원택, 무소속 김관영 후보가 접전을 벌이고 있다.)

If the Rebuilding Korea Party and independent candidates capture several basic local government head positions in South Jeolla and Gwangju, it could become a negative factor for Director Jeong’s re-election. As of August last year, 32.9% of the Democratic Party’s paid members were from the Honam region. A ruling party official said, “Whether Director Jeong can earn the support of Honam party members and perform well in the next national convention hinges on this Honam local election.” (조국혁신당과 무소속 후보들에게 전남·광주 지역 기초단체장 자리를 여럿 내준다면 정 대표 연임에 악재가 될 수 있다. 작년 8월 기준 민주당 권리당원 중 32.9%가 호남 당원이다. 여권 관계자는 “정 대표가 차기 전당대회에서도 호남 당원 표심을 얻고 선전할지 여부가 이번 호남 지방선거에 달렸다”고 했다.)

Within the People Power Party, there is a possibility that responsibility for the nomination turmoil could be pinned on Director Jang. The nomination management committee chairperson Lee Jung-hyun, appointed by Director Jang, caused controversy by cutting off (excluding from nomination) lawmaker Joo Ho-young and current People Power Party Daegu Dalseong candidate Lee Jin-sook in the Daegu mayoral nomination. Even after candidate Choo Kyung-ho was ultimately selected, divisions among supporters persisted for a while, leading to a close race with Democratic Party candidate Kim Boo-kyum. (국민의힘에선 공천 파동과 관련해 장 대표 책임론이 불거질 가능성도 있다. 장 대표가 임명한 이정현 공천관리위원장은 대구시장 후보 공천에서 주호영 의원과 이진숙 현 국민의힘 대구 달성 후보를 컷오프(공천 배제)해 논란이 됐다. 추경호 후보가 최종 선출된 이후에도 지지층 분열이 한동안 지속됐고, 민주당 김부겸 후보와의 접전으로 이어졌다.)

In North Chungcheong, there was commotion over cutting off current North Chungcheong Governor Kim Young-hwan as a candidate and registering former lawmaker Kim Soo-min as an additional candidate. The noise was barely resolved after Kim Young-hwan’s court injunction was granted and Kim Soo-min withdrew her candidacy. In Ulsan, after former Ulsan Mayor Park Maeng-woo, who was cut off, ran as an independent, a conservative unification with People Power Party candidate Kim Doo-gyeom failed. In contrast, the broader ruling camp unified behind Democratic Party candidate Kim Sang-wook. An opposition official said, “If losses occur in two or more of these regions, Director Jang will inevitably have to take responsibility in some way.” (충북은 김영환 현 충북지사 후보를 컷오프하고, 김수민 전 의원을 추가 후보 등록을 시키는 등의 잡음이 있었다. 김영환 후보의 법원 가처분 신청이 인용되고 김 전 의원의 후보 사퇴로 공천 잡음이 겨우 수습됐다. 울산도 컷오프된 박맹우 전 울산시장의 무소속 출마 이후 국민의힘 김두겸 후보와의 보수 단일화는 실패한 상태다. 반면 범여권은 민주당 김상욱 후보로 단일화했다. 야권 관계자는 “이들 지역 중에 두 곳 이상 패배가 나온다면, 장 대표가 어떤 식으로든 책임질 수밖에 없다”고 했다.)

Representatives Jeong Cheong-rae and Jang Dong-hyeok are also closely watching the results of the 14 National Assembly by-elections held alongside the local elections. Among the 14 seats, 13 were held by the Democratic Party, and if they lose more seats to the opposition, it could be a setback for Director Jeong. There is also talk that if independent candidate Han Dong-hoon, whom Director Jang expelled, wins the Busan Buk-gu Gap election, it will be difficult for Jang to avoid political responsibility. Intense conflicts are likely to erupt over Director Jang’s resignation among pro-power factions, pro-friendly factions, and younger lawmakers. (정청래·장동혁 대표는 지방선거와 함께 치러지는 14곳의 국회의원 재·보궐선거 결과에도 촉각을 곤두세우고 있다. 14곳 중 13곳이 민주당 지역구였는데, 야당에 의석을 더 뺏긴다면 정 대표에겐 악재가 될 수 있다. 부산 북갑 선거에서 장 대표가 제명한 무소속 한동훈 후보가 당선된다면, 정치적 책임을 피하기 어렵다는 말도 나온다. 당권파와 친한계·소장파 간 장 대표 퇴진 등을 두고 격렬한 다툼을 벌일 가능성이 크다.)

The Democratic Party will hold its next national convention around late August or early September. Potential candidates for party leader include Representative Jeong Cheong-rae, Prime Minister Kim Min-seok, and former leader Song Young-gil. A Democratic Party official said, “Within the party, attention is already focused on the upcoming national convention, which is expected to become ‘Season 2 of the Myeong-Cheong showdown,’” adding, “Director Jeong’s fate depends on whether this election results in a landslide victory or not.” (민주당은 8월 말, 9월 초쯤 차기 전당대회를 연다. 정청래 대표를 비롯해 김민석 국무총리, 송영길 전 대표 등이 당대표 출마자로 거론된다. 민주당 관계자는 “당내에선 이미 ‘명청 대전’ 시즌 2가 될 전망인 차기 전당대회에 눈길이 쏠린 상황”이라며 “이번 선거가 압승이냐 아니냐에 정 대표 운명이 걸렸다”고 했다.)

The People Power Party still has 1 year and 3 months left in Director Jang Dong-hyeok’s term, but there are already calls for his early resignation within the party. A People Power Party official said, “If we fail to win at least half of the regional government head elections, talk of an early national convention becomes inevitable,” adding, “There is a possibility that the power structure within the party could undergo a complex reorganization.” (국민의힘은 장동혁 대표 임기가 1년 3개월 남았지만 당내에선 조기 퇴진론이 나오는 상황이다. 국민의힘 관계자는 “광역 단체장 선거를 최소 절반 이상 이기지 못하면, 조기 전당대회 얘기가 나올 수밖에 없다”며 “당내 권력 구도가 복잡하게 재편될 가능성이 있다”고 했다.)

item.title: Cho Kuk and Han Dong-hoon Entering Yeouido Could Signal a Shift in the Ruling and Opposition Power Structure (조국·한동훈 여의도 입성 땐, 여야 권력구도에 변화 예고)
item.description:
Cho Kuk and Han Dong-hoon Entering Yeouido Could Signal a Shift in the Ruling and Opposition Power Structure (조국·한동훈 여의도 입성 땐, 여야 권력구도에 변화 예고)

One of the biggest points of interest in the June 3 election is whether the leading candidates from the ruling and opposition parties will enter Yeouido. In particular, the outcome of Cho Kuk, the candidate from the Cho Kuk Innovation Party in Pyeongtaek-b, Gyeonggi Province, and Han Dong-hoon, the candidate in Buk-gu, Busan’s Gap district, is expected to reshape the power dynamics in the political arena. Attention is also focused on whether independent candidate Kim Gwan-young, expelled from the Democratic Party, will secure the Jeonbuk Governor position. <<> Within the opposition bloc, there is a view that if Cho Kuk wins, he will emerge as a leading figure. In this election, Cho considered running in Honam regions like Gwangju and Gunsan, Jeonbuk, where victory would be easier, but ultimately chose Pyeongtaek-b, a more challenging five-way race. If he defeats candidates from both the Democratic Party and the People Power Party and enters the National Assembly, his influence is expected to grow. Particularly, if Cho enters the legislature, the 12-seat Cho Kuk Innovation Party could gain momentum, potentially giving it some leverage in future discussions about merging with the Democratic Party. An opposition source said, “A victory for Cho will consolidate the scattered pro-Roh and pro-Moon factions,” adding, “It could also lead to a reorganization within the opposition.” <<> Han Dong-hoon, who was expelled from the People Power Party and is running as an independent, is also expected to rise as a key opposition figure if elected. Notably, with Han hinting at rejoining the People Power Party, a fierce clash with the faction led by party leader Jang Dong-hyuk is anticipated. A People Power Party official expressed concern, saying, “Depending on whether Han wins, we fear a worst-case scenario where the party could split.” However, if both Cho and Han lose, they have pledged to ‘bury their bones’ in Pyeongtaek-b and Busan Buk-gu, Gap, respectively, suggesting they will regroup with an eye on the 2028 general election, two years from now. <<> If Kim Gwan-young, expelled from the Democratic Party amid the ‘proxy payment controversy,’ succeeds in his re-election bid for the Jeonbuk Governor position, the fallout within the opposition could be significant. An opposition source noted, “Kim would become the first independent metropolitan government head in Honam,” and added, “He could emerge as a Honam candidate, having fought against the giant ruling party leader, Chung Cheong-rae.” Meanwhile, within the Democratic Party, if former leader Song Young-gil in Incheon Yeonsu-gu Gap and former Gangwon Governor Lee Kwang-jae in Hanam-si Gap, Gyeonggi Province, win this election, there are expectations for them to take on roles as senior figures. A Democratic Party official said, “There are also rumors about them running for the next party leadership or joining the cabinet.” (6·3 선거의 최대 관심사 중 하나는 여야 대표 주자들의 여의도 입성 여부다. 특히 경기 평택을 조국 조국혁신당 후보, 부산 북갑 한동훈 후보의 승패에 따라 정치권의 권력지형 변화가 예상된다. 민주당에서 제명된 무소속 김관영 후보의 전북지사 당선 여부에도 관심이 쏠리고 있다.)

item.title: Ruling and Opposition Parties: "Out of 16 Races, 6-8 Are Battlegrounds"... Seoul and Busan Are Key Battlegrounds (與野 “16곳 중 접전지 6~8곳”… 서울·부산이 최대 승부처)
item.description:
Ruling and Opposition Parties: "Out of 16 Races, 6-8 Are Battlegrounds"... Seoul and Busan Are Key Battlegrounds (與野 “16곳 중 접전지 6~8곳”… 서울·부산이 최대 승부처)

On June 1, the day before the local elections, the Democratic Party of Korea classified 6 of the 16 provincial and metropolitan mayoral races as battlegrounds, while the People Power Party identified 8. Although recent polls show the Democratic Party generally leading, the People Power Party anticipates a last-minute consolidation of conservative voters. In particular, there are forecasts that the outcome of the Seoul and Busan mayoral elections—seen as key regions by both parties—will shape the assessment of victory or defeat. (지방선거를 하루 앞둔 2일 더불어민주당은 16곳 시·도지사 선거 가운데 6곳, 국민의힘은 8곳을 접전지로 분류했다. 최근 여론조사에서 민주당이 전반적으로 앞서고 있지만 국민의힘은 막판 보수 유권자의 결집을 기대하고 있다. 특히 양당이 핵심 지역으로 꼽는 서울·부산시장 선거 결과에 따라 승패에 대한 평가가 달라질 것이라는 전망도 나온다.)

The Democratic Party evaluates 9 regions—including Incheon, Daejeon, Sejong, Gyeonggi, Gangwon, North Chungcheong, South Chungcheong, South Jeolla/Gwangju, and Jeju—as strongholds, expecting a "9+α (alpha)" win, which is a majority of the 16 races. Its goal is to add victories in battlegrounds such as Seoul, Busan, Daegu, Ulsan, North Jeolla, and South Gyeongnam, securing double-digit wins in provincial leadership positions. North Gyeongsang is classified as a weak area. In the 2018 local elections under the Moon Jae-in administration, the Democratic Party won 14 of 17 provincial and metropolitan mayoral races, excluding Daegu, North Gyeongsang, and Jeju. (민주당은 인천, 대전, 세종, 경기, 강원, 충북, 충남, 전남·광주, 제주 등 9곳을 우세 지역으로 평가하면서, 16곳 가운데 과반인 ‘9+α(알파)’ 승리를 기대하고 있다. 여기에 접전지로 분류한 서울, 부산, 대구, 울산, 전북, 경남의 승리를 보태서 두 자릿수 광역단체장 석권에 나서겠다는 것이 목표다. 경북은 열세 지역으로 분류된다. 문재인 정부 때인 2018년 지방선거에서 민주당은 17곳 시·도지사 선거 가운데 대구, 경북, 제주를 제외한 14곳에서 승리했다.)

Democratic Party Secretary-General Cho Seung-rae said at a press briefing that day, "Six provincial leadership positions are still battlegrounds," adding, "Among them, Seoul, Busan, and South Gyeongsang are neck-and-neck until the end." A Democratic Party official remarked, "The support rates in the 9 stronghold regions are relatively stable, but the last day is crucial in the battlegrounds." (민주당 조승래 사무총장은 이날 기자간담회에서 “광역단체장 6곳은 여전히 접전”이라면서 “이 가운데 서울, 부산, 경남은 끝까지 접전이 이어지고 있다”고 말했다. 민주당 관계자는 “우세 지역 9곳은 비교적 안정적으로 지지율이 관리되고 있지만 접전지에서는 마지막 하루가 중요하다”고 말했다.)

The People Power Party classified 8 regions—Seoul, Busan, Daejeon, Ulsan, Gangwon, North Chungcheong, South Chungcheong, and South Gyeongsang—as battlegrounds. Among these, it separately identified 5 regions—Seoul, Busan, Gangwon, South Chungcheong, and South Gyeongsang—as "super-battlegrounds," where the outcome hinges on final voter turnout. A key People Power Party official said, "Daejeon, North Chungcheong, and Ulsan are also worth contesting." (국민의힘은 서울, 부산, 대전, 울산, 강원, 충북, 충남, 경남 등 8곳을 접전지로 분류했다. 이 가운데에서도 서울, 부산, 강원, 충남, 경남 등 5곳은 최종 투표율에 따라 승부가 기우는 ‘초접전지’로 별도로 꼽았다. 국민의힘 핵심 관계자는 “대전, 충북, 울산에서도 충분히 해볼 만하다”고 말했다.)

The People Power Party evaluated Daegu and North Gyeongsang as strongholds. Although polls in Daegu showed a tight race between the ruling and opposition parties, it analyzed that conservative supporters are consolidating at the last minute. The People Power Party considers 6 regions—including Incheon and Sejong, where incumbent mayors are from the People Power Party, along with Gyeonggi, North Jeolla, South Jeolla/Gwangju, and Jeju—as weak areas. (국민의힘은 대구·경북을 우세 지역으로 평가했다. 대구의 경우 여론조사에서 여야가 접전 양상까지 보였지만 보수 지지층이 막판 결집하고 있다고 분석했다. 국민의힘은 현직 시장이 국민의힘 소속인 인천, 세종을 포함해 경기, 전북, 전남·광주, 제주 등 6곳을 열세로 판단하고 있다.)

The battlegrounds commonly cited by both parties are Seoul, Busan, Ulsan, and South Gyeongsang. In these regions, the outcome is expected to hinge on "how effectively each party can turn out its supporters to the polls." The early voting rate over the two days of May 29–30 reached 23.51%, an all-time high. A Democratic Party official stated, "At this stage, it's less about poll numbers and more about who gets more people to the polling stations," adding, "In Seoul and Busan, the final turnout is a key variable." A senior People Power Party official also said, "Ultimately, the in-person voting turnout will decide the outcome," and noted, "In Seoul, the final turnout in the strongly conservative districts of Gangnam, Seocho, and Songpa could tip the scales." (여야가 공통적으로 꼽은 접전지는 서울, 부산, 울산, 경남 등 4곳이다. 이 지역에서는 ‘지지층을 얼마나 투표소로 이끌어내느냐’에 따라 승패가 갈릴 전망이다. 지난 29~30일 이틀간 진행된 사전투표율은 23.51%로 역대 최고치를 기록했다. 민주당 관계자는 “지금은 여론조사 수치보다 누가 더 많이 투표장에 나오느냐가 중요한 국면”이라며 “서울과 부산은 마지막 투표율이 핵심 변수”라고 말했다. 국민의힘 고위 당직자도 “결국 본투표 참여율이 승부를 가를 것”이라며 “서울의 경우 보수세가 강한 강남·서초·송파구의 최종 투표율이 얼마나 높게 형성되는지에 따라 승부가 기울 수도 있다”고 했다.)

The ruling party is also closely monitoring the North Jeolla gubernatorial race, where Democratic Party candidate Lee Won-taek faces independent candidate Kim Kwan-young. The Democratic Party expelled Kim, the former incumbent governor, just before the candidate nomination over a "controversy over payment of designated driver fees." In response, Kim launched an independent campaign, turning it into a battleground. The two candidates were locked in a fierce contest until just before the poll blackout period. Within the Democratic Party, there are assessments that Lee's support rate is stabilizing. Democratic Party Secretary-General Cho Seung-rae also diagnosed, "The somewhat chaotic situation (in North Jeolla) is being resolved." (여권은 민주당 이원택 후보와 무소속 김관영 후보가 맞붙는 전북지사 선거 판세에도 촉각을 곤두세우고 있다. 민주당은 공천 직전 ‘대리 운전비 지급 논란’으로 현직 전북지사였던 김 후보를 제명했다. 그러자 김 후보가 반발하며 무소속으로 출마해 접전지가 됐다. 두 후보는 여론조사 블랙아웃(공표 금지) 기간 직전까지 치열한 접전 양상을 보였다. 민주당 내부에선 이 후보의 지지율이 안정되는 흐름으로 이어지고 있다는 평가도 나오고 있다. 민주당 조승래 사무총장도 “(전북에서) 다소 혼란스러운 상황들이 정리되고 있다”고 진단했다.)

The People Power Party is focusing on the Chungcheong region. It claims that in the final stages of the campaign, support rates are rising in tandem in areas like Daejeon, North Chungcheong, and South Chungcheong. An analysis suggests that People Power Party leader Jang Dong-hyuk, whose constituency is Boryeong-Seocheon in South Chungcheong, devoted six days to campaigning in the Chungcheong region from May 21, when official campaigning began, until today, is not unrelated to this. On the day before the local elections, Jang visited Cheongyang, Gongju, and Dangjin in South Chungcheong in succession. (국민의힘은 충청 지역에 주목하고 있다. 선거 막판 대전·충북·충남 등지에서 지지율 동반 상승 흐름이 나타나고 있다는 것이다. 충남 보령·서천이 지역구인 국민의힘 장동혁 대표가 공식 선거운동이 시작된 지난달 21일부터 이날까지 충청 유세에 6일을 할애한 것도 이와 무관하지 않다는 분석이 나온다. 장 대표는 지방선거를 하루 앞둔 이날도 충남 청양, 공주, 당진을 연이어 방문했다.)

item.title: Voter turnout at 7 a.m. stands at 2.0%... Higher than previous local and general elections (오전 7시 투표율 2.0%...직전 지선·총선보다 높아 )
item.description:
The National Election Commission announced that as of 7 a.m. on the 3rd, when the June 3 nationwide local elections and National Assembly by-elections are being held, the voter turnout was recorded at 2.0%. This is higher than the voter turnout in the previous local elections in 2022 and the 2024 general elections. In the early voting, the turnout hit a record high for local elections (23.51%). (6·3 전국동시지방선거와 국회의원 재·보궐선거 본투표이 진행되는 3일 오전 7시 기준 투표율은 2.0%로 집계됐다고 중앙선거관리위원회가 밝혔다. 직전 지방선거인 2022년 및 2024년 총선보다 높은 투표율이다. 앞선 사전투표에서 투표율은 지방선거 기준 역대 최고치(23.51%)를 기록했다.)

Compared to the turnout at the same time in previous elections, this figure is 0.3 percentage points (p) higher than the 8th local elections in 2022 (1.7%). It is also higher than the 22nd general elections in 2024 (1.8%). However, it fell short of the 21st presidential election (2.4%) held last year. (지난 선거와 동시간대 투표율을 비교하면 2022년 제8회 지방선거(1.7%)보다 0.3%포인트(p) 높다. 2024년 22대 총선(1.8%)보다도 높은 수치다. 다만 지난해 치러진 21대 대선(2.4%)에는 못 미쳤다.)

As of 7 a.m., the voter turnout was highest in North Gyeongsang Province at 2.6%, and lowest in Sejong at 1.4%. Seoul recorded 1.7%. Following the record-high early voting turnout for local elections, attention is focused on whether the high voting enthusiasm will continue in today's main voting. (오전 7시 기준 투표율은 경북이 2.6%로 전국에서 가장 높았고, 세종(1.4%)이 가장 낮았다. 서울은 1.7%로 나타났다. 지방선거 기준 역대 최고 사전 투표율을 기록한 데 이어 오늘 본투표에서도 높은 투표 열기가 이어질지 주목된다.)

Unlike early voting, which allowed voting at any polling station with just an ID, for the main voting, voters must go to designated polling stations based on their registered address. Voting runs from 6 a.m. to 6 p.m., and voters need to bring an ID such as a resident registration card or passport. When marking a ballot, voters must use the dedicated stamp provided inside the voting booth. (신분증만 있으면 투표소 어디서나 투표가 가능했던 사전투표와 달리 본투표는 주소지에 따라 지정된 투표소를 찾아가야 한다. 투표는 오전 6시부터 오후 6시까지 진행되며 주민등록증이나 여권 등 신분증을 챙겨야 한다. 기표할 땐 반드시 기표소 안에 비치된 전용 도장을 사용해야 한다.)
